the energetics and structural effects of molecular recognition in the proton-bound complexes of acetylated amino acid (AcAA) and 18-crown–6.
the structural and energetic effects of acetylation of the N-terminal and side chain amino groups of Lys residues in peptides and proteins on the 18C6−H+ binding affinity.
the structural and energetic effects in the molecular recognition of acetylated amino acid side chains by 18C6.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
18C6 binds to the N-terminal acetylation of Lys residues with the highest binding affinity and to the side chain acetylation of His and Arg residues with lower binding affinities.
18C6 has the highest affinity for N-terminal acetylation sites, followed by side chain acetylation sites and finally the N-terminal amino groups.

the Nε–Ac side chain of LYS has the highest binding affinity with 18C6.
